name: Centre de Yoga Iyengar de La Rochelle
reason: No usable contact route: its own site (iyengar-larochelle.com, robots.txt allows us) has no contact form, and the only email is built by a script (javascript:mailA) and shown as text split with spaces, which counts as an obfuscated email and was not reassembled; only a phone number is published plainly. For the owner: could come back if the owner accepts the spaced address or the centre adds a form.
